purpose: Classify OLD Project Doctor files and entrypoints by actual retirement dependency after required-check cutover and OLD PR-trigger shutdown. This inventory does not infer deletion safety from incomplete GitHub code search results.

RETIRE_AFTER_ROLLBACK_WINDOW_CLOSES.reason: These are OLD Doctor operational orchestration/impact/planning/guard/freshness entrypoints. NEW Project Check does not import them, but the retained OLD manual rollback workflow still uses the Doctor runtime until final deletion.

DEFER_UNTIL_STATUS_SOURCE_WRITER_CUTOVER.reason: NEW R1 Status Source runtime is complete but its production writer is still disabled. Deleting OLD status-source writer/lifecycle surfaces before ownership cutover risks leaving no production mutation path.

DEFER_UNTIL_PROJECT_STATUS_WRITER_CUTOVE.reason: NEW R2 Project Status is read-only and its canonical writer remains disabled. OLD generated Project Status outputs must not be removed until NEW writer ownership and downstream consumer compatibility are proven.

RETAIN_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE.reason: Frozen R0/R1/R2/R3 migration checkpoints cite OLD contracts and validation artifacts as parity/reference evidence. They are no longer runtime predecessors but should remain addressable until an explicit archive policy replaces those references.

PRESERVE_NON_DOCTOR_SHARED_OR_PRESENTATI.reason: Names containing project-doctor are not sufficient evidence of OLD Doctor ownership. Hosted QA belongs to frontend/hosted QA and shared domain validators remain independent Project Check validators.

reasons: Status Source production writer ownership has not cut over.
Project Status canonical writer ownership has not cut over.

reviews: GitHub code search returned incomplete_results for exact generated-output reference queries and is therefore not used as evidence that consumers are absent.
